title: A Geometry-Material Aware Point Cloud Transformer for Large-scale Unstructured Thermal Analysis in 2.5D ICs
problem: Thermal management in large-scale unstructured 2.5D ICs requires modeling complex geometries and heterogeneous materials while maintaining memory efficiency.
motivation: Dense 2.5D integration creates multiscale thermal challenges; existing DL methods need efficient unstructured representation and material-aware adaptation.
method: Therm-PCT uses point-cloud transformer with adaptive multipath-coupled diffusion (AMD) for heat diffusion, wavelet-based fine-grained recovery (WFR) for thermal gradients, and thermal-aware Mixture-of-Material-Experts (TA-MoME) for material-specific routing.
key_novelty: Geometry-material aware point-cloud transformer with wavelet enhancement and expert routing for thermal prediction in complex 2.5D systems.
contributions: Zero-shot generalization to 5.7× larger point clouds
limitations: Point-cloud approach may not capture fine geometric details; generalization to completely novel geometries not demonstrated.
primary_theme: Deep learning thermal prediction for heterogeneous 2.5D ICs
